description: This Java interface defines a live command related to retrieving feature properties within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends multiple interfaces to incorporate command behaviors, query capabilities, and feature identification functionality, serving as an entry point for creating answer builders for incoming commands.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturePropertiesLiveCommand
classes.description: An interface that provides access to retrieve feature properties via a live command, including methods to create answer builders and access feature identifiers.
